gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.

gaps.sentence: The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.
She spoke with great ___ (WISE) about the risks.
The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).

gaps.explanation: 'Optimistic' is the adjective; 'optimism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (OWN) of the car park charges by the hour.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — the person who owns it; 'ownership' is the state.
